card.title: THE POMPADOURS
card.text: While in hand, your HQ gets +1 defense each time you play a card with Bond.
card.flavorText: The Essex Regiment existed from 1881 to 1958 and served with distinction throughout WWII. The regiment’s battalions were deployed in various roles across multiple theaters. In 1940 the 2nd battalion was attached to the 50th (Northumbrian) Infantry Division and served with the British Expeditionary Force in France in 1940. The battalion was evacuated from Dunkirk after the short but fierce Battle of Dunkirk and remained stationed in the UK for home defense duties before joining the 3rd Infantry Division to take part in Operation Overlord. It landed on Sword Beach during the Normandy invasion on 6 June 1944. In the weeks that followed, the battalion was engaged in intense fighting to secure Caen and push through German defenses in northern France. Other battalions of the Regiment served in the Middle East and Italy, contributing to key operations including the North African campaign and the advance through Italy. The Essex Regiment had purple facings, which were rare and distinctive. This color became closely associated with their identity and led to their nickname, "The Pompadours", a reference to Madame de Pompadour, who favored purple.
